name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Every job I've had, I've ended up building the training materials, onboarding process, or playbook nobody assigned me to build, then handing it off when I moved on. This role is the first time that work would be the whole job instead of the thing I did on the side of a quota, which is exactly why it caught my attention.

At Wix, I built the sales training curriculum for tenured account executives, not just new hires, while running onboarding for a team that scaled to 20 people. At Birdeye, I built the training sequences and communication workflows that onboarded a partner network of 15-20 resellers end to end. At Solenzo today, I write the instructional content, playbooks, and reusable messaging frameworks my clients' teams run their operations on. Different products, same instinct: turn what one person knows into something a whole team can use.
I'd welcome the chance to talk through how that experience fits what you're building at Ookla. I'm at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
